verdict.rationale: Orb documents a REST API with reference pages, pagination, idempotency and multi-language SDKs, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The llms.txt file is a docs index, not an API spec, and SDKs are adjacent building blocks rather than the spec itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
